name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A 'Notifications' switch using the enclosing-label pattern that starts checked and slides its thumb between on/off states when toggled.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — `defaultChecked` on Switch.Root with no React state; the component manages checked state internally
nonTrivialInteractions: Clicking anywhere in the enclosing <label> toggles the switch (the label wraps Switch.Root, the simplest labeling pattern)
Checked-state styling is driven by the `data-checked` attribute: the track swaps background and the thumb slides via translate-x
Keyboard toggling (Space/Enter) is available through the switch's rendered interactive element with a visible focus outline
